newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Northern Trust to open office in S'pore.
newsitem.headline: Northern Trust to open office in S'pore.

text.p: Securities custodian and trustee The Northern Trust Company said on Tuesday it would establish a 24-hour foreign exchange trading capability in the region when its Singapore office opens on October 15.

The office would complement its securities lending and investment management services in Hong Kong, and perform roles of custody client servicing, business development and treasury management activities, it said in a statement.
It named Jeffrey Conover as general manager of the Singapore branch, which would initially employ a staff of 14.
Northern Trust, headquartered in Chicago, operates a network of subcustodians in 72 markets around the world.
